ns2:course.label: Contemporary Media Literacy
ns2:course.description: Develops skills to assess the importance of new media in contemporary culture. The course emphasizes both social and technical aspects of media. As part of the course, students prepare their own media and evaluate current media literacy projects. Prerequisite: Freshman or sophomore standing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
